description:
Mindex is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Product division. You'll design and build cloud-native applications on .NET and AWS, using AI-assisted engineering practices throughout the development lifecycle. You'll work closely with Product, Test Engineering, Support, and CloudOps to deliver reusable services and reliable infrastructure. The ideal candidate is a curious, detail-oriented engineer eager to own solutions end-to-end and adopt modern AI-assisted workflows.
 We welcome candidates from a variety of locations; however, all candidates should be open to occasional in-person participation for business meetings, team events, or collaboration opportunities. Candidates located within approximately 35 miles of Rochester, NY may be asked to work from the office more frequently based on business or team needs.  
 Compensation 
 $70,000 - $120,000
 
 What You'll Accomplish 
 Apply AI-assisted engineering practices (AI DLC) across the development lifecycle, sharing effective workflows and patterns with the team.
 Design and maintain APIs, background services, and reusable business logic using .NET and C#.
 Build customer-facing features, including UI, Blazor apps, and .NET MAUI mobile functionality.
 Develop cloud-native solutions and infrastructure as code on AWS, and support CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
 Implement observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting) and investigate production issues to identify root causes.
 Apply security, privacy, and least-privilege principles across application and infrastructure work.
 Participate in technical design, estimation, code reviews, and incremental delivery.
 Collaborate with Product, Test Engineering, Support, and CloudOps to resolve dependencies and deliver complete solutions.
 Document architecture and technical decisions to support long-term maintainability.
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
 Three or more years of software engineering experience developing and supporting production systems.
 Experience with AI-assisted development tools and structured practices such as the AI DLC, including evaluating AI-generated output against normal engineering standards.
 Experience developing applications and services using .NET, C#, Web API, ASP.NET MVC, and RESTful APIs, including reusable services and shared business logic.
 Experience building web and cross-platform applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AngularJS, Blazor, and .NET MAUI.
 Working knowledge of relational database design, SQL, and performance troubleshooting.
 Hands-on experience with AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, CloudFront, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager, IAM, and CloudWatch, and understanding of cloud architecture, security, and high availability.
 Experience with infrastructure as code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines, preferably Azure DevOps.
 Experience implementing observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting) and troubleshooting distributed applications and production issues.
 Experience with automated testing, source control, code review, and Agile delivery in cross-functional teams.
 Strong communication, collaboration, and technical documentation skills.
 
 Licenses & Certifications: 
 AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect) are a plus.
 
 Why Join Mindex? 
 For more than 30 years, Mindex has helped organizations solve complex business challenges through custom software, cloud, data, and AI solutions. We combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative culture that empowers our employees to innovate, grow, and make a meaningful impact for our clients.
 In our Product division, our teams have built platforms such as SchoolTool, Advanced Analytics, and our Integrations Platform from the ground up, while also supporting solutions like MTSS Edge and ClearTrack that help schools and organizations make smarter, data-driven decisions.
 Benefits 
 Fully Remote Work Environment
 Flexible Time Off
 Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
 401(k) with Company Match
 Company-Paid Life and Disability Insurance
 Professional Development Opportunities
 
 Additional Information 
 Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Mindex is unable to sponsor employment visas at this time.
 
 Physical Requirements/Conditions 
 Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
 No heavy lifting is expected. Exertion of up to 10 lbs.
